lessons.title: Greetings
lessons.subtitle: 第一课 · Greeting people at church
lessons.scenario: You've just arrived at church on a Sunday morning. People are greeting each other warmly at the door.

dialogue.speaker: Wei Ming
dialogue.pinyin: Nǐ hǎo!
dialogue.english: Hello!

dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.pinyin: Nǐ hǎo! Zǎo ān!
dialogue.english: Hello! Good morning!

dialogue.speaker: Wei Ming
dialogue.pinyin: Huānyíng lái jiàohuì!
dialogue.english: Welcome to church!

dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.pinyin: Xièxie nǐ!
dialogue.english: Thank you!

dialogue.speaker: Wei Ming
dialogue.pinyin: Píng'ān!
dialogue.english: Peace be with you!

dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.pinyin: Píng'ān! Zàijiàn!
dialogue.english: Peace! See you later!

vocabulary.note: The most common everyday greeting.
Used before noon.
Often heard from greeters at the door.
The community, not just the building.
Polite and warm, used often.
A common greeting among Singapore Protestant believers, often short for 主内平安 ('peace in the Lord').
Literally 'see again.'

quiz.question: How would a greeter welcome you at the door?

lessons.challenge: Greet one person in Chinese this week — even just "你好" or "平安."

verse.chinese: 爱弟兄，要彼此亲热；恭敬人，要彼此推让。
verse.pinyin: ài dì xiōng， yào bǐ cǐ qīn rè； gōng jìng rén， yào bǐ cǐ tuī ràng。

lessons.title: Introducing Yourself
lessons.subtitle: 第二课 · Meeting someone after service
lessons.scenario: After the service, someone new sits next to you at the fellowship table and asks your name.

dialogue.speaker: Hui Ling
dialogue.pinyin: Nǐ jiào shénme míngzi?
dialogue.english: What's your name?

dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.pinyin: Wǒ jiào Dàwèi. Nǐ ne?
dialogue.english: My name is David. And you?

dialogue.speaker: Hui Ling
dialogue.chinese: 我叫慧玲。很高兴认识你。
dialogue.pinyin: Wǒ jiào Huìlíng. Hěn gāoxìng rènshi nǐ.
dialogue.english: My name is Hui Ling. Nice to meet you.

dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.pinyin: Wǒ yě hěn gāoxìng rènshi nǐ.
dialogue.english: Nice to meet you too.

dialogue.speaker: Hui Ling
dialogue.chinese: 欢迎你！希望我们可以成为朋友，也认识更多弟兄姊妹。
dialogue.pinyin: Huānyíng nǐ! Xīwàng wǒmen kěyǐ chéngwéi péngyǒu, yě rènshi gèng duō dìxiōng zǐmèi.
dialogue.english: Welcome! I hope we can become friends, and that you'll get to know more brothers and sisters here.

vocabulary.note: Standard way to introduce yourself.
Common term for male fellow believers.
Common term for female fellow believers.

quiz.question: How do you ask someone's name?
How do you say "nice to meet you"?

lessons.challenge: Introduce yourself in Chinese to someone at church this week.

verse.chinese: 所以，你们要彼此接纳，如同基督接纳你们一样，使荣耀归与神。
verse.pinyin: suǒ yǐ， nǐ men yào bǐ cǐ jiē nà， rú tóng jī dū jiē nà nǐ men yī yàng， shǐ róng yào guī yǔ shén。

lessons.title: Meeting Someone New
lessons.subtitle: 第三课 · Small talk after the service
lessons.scenario: You're chatting with a newcomer over coffee after the service, learning a little about them.

dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.pinyin: Nǐ shì dì yī cì lái ma?
dialogue.english: Is this your first time here?

dialogue.speaker: Jia Hui
dialogue.pinyin: Shì de, wǒ shì dì yī cì lái.
dialogue.english: Yes, this is my first time.

dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.pinyin: Nǐ zhù zài fùjìn ma?
dialogue.english: Do you live nearby?

dialogue.speaker: Jia Hui
dialogue.pinyin: Duì, wǒ zhù de bù yuǎn.
dialogue.english: Yes, I don't live far.

dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.chinese: 太好了！希望你下周再来。
dialogue.pinyin: Tài hǎo le! Xīwàng nǐ xià zhōu zài lái.
dialogue.english: Great! I hope you'll come again next week.

vocabulary.note: A warm, common expression of enthusiasm.

quiz.question: How do you ask "is this your first time?"

lessons.challenge: Ask someone new at church one question about themselves in Chinese.

verse.chinese: 不可忘记用爱心接待客旅；因为曾有接待客旅的，不知不觉就接待了天使。
verse.pinyin: bù kě wàng jì yòng ài xīn jiē dài kè lǚ； yīn wèi céng yǒu jiē dài kè lǚ de， bù zhī bù jué jiù jiē dài le tiān shǐ。

lessons.title: Church Tour
lessons.subtitle: 第四课 · Finding your way around
lessons.scenario: A volunteer is showing a newcomer around the church building before the service starts.

dialogue.speaker: Wei Ming
dialogue.pinyin: Zhè shì zhǔ táng.
dialogue.english: This is the main sanctuary.

dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.pinyin: Xǐshǒujiān zài nǎlǐ?
dialogue.english: Where's the restroom?

dialogue.speaker: Wei Ming
dialogue.pinyin: Zài nà biān, yòu biān.
dialogue.english: Over there, on the right.

dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.pinyin: Értóng zhǔrìxué zài nǎlǐ?
dialogue.english: Where's children's Sunday school?

dialogue.speaker: Wei Ming
dialogue.chinese: 在楼上，左边第二间教室。
dialogue.pinyin: Zài lóu shàng, zuǒ biān dì èr jiān jiàoshì.
dialogue.english: Upstairs, the second classroom on the left.

quiz.question: How do you ask "where is it?"
What does 儿童主日学 mean?

lessons.challenge: Practice asking "洗手间在哪里？" out loud three times this week.

verse.chinese: （大卫上行之诗）人对我说：我们往耶和华的殿去，我就欢喜。
verse.pinyin: （ dà wèi shàng háng zhī shī） rén duì wǒ shuō： wǒ men wǎng yē hé huá de diàn qù， wǒ jiù huān xǐ。

lessons.title: Sunday Service
lessons.subtitle: 第五课 · Following along in worship
lessons.scenario: The service is about to begin. An usher gives you a bulletin and a friend tells you what's coming up.

dialogue.speaker: Kevin
dialogue.pinyin: Qǐng zuò, chóngbài kuài kāishǐ le.
dialogue.english: Please sit, the service is about to start.

dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.chinese: 谢谢。今天讲道是关于什么？
dialogue.pinyin: Xièxie. Jīntiān jiǎngdào shì guānyú shénme?
dialogue.english: Thanks. What's today's sermon about?

dialogue.speaker: Hui Ling
dialogue.pinyin: Shì guānyú ēndiǎn de.
dialogue.english: It's about grace.

dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.chinese: 太好了，我们先唱诗歌吗？
dialogue.pinyin: Tài hǎo le, wǒmen xiān chàng shīgē ma?
dialogue.english: Great, do we sing songs first?

dialogue.speaker: Hui Ling
dialogue.pinyin: Duì, ránhòu dǎogào, zài jiǎngdào.
dialogue.english: Yes, then prayer, then the sermon.

vocabulary.note: The standard term in Singapore Protestant churches (as in 主日崇拜, 'Sunday worship service'). You may also hear 礼拜 used colloquially, especially for 'attending church' (做礼拜).
The term used throughout the Chinese Union Version (和合本, CUVS) Bible.
Polite and warm, used often.
A warm, common expression of enthusiasm.

lessons.challenge: Listen for the words 讲道, 诗歌, and 祷告 during this week's service.

verse.chinese: 你们不可停止聚会，好像那些停止惯了的人，倒要彼此劝勉，既知道〔原文作看见〕那日子临近，就更当如此。
verse.pinyin: nǐ men bù kě tíng zhǐ jù huì， hǎo xiàng nà xiē tíng zhǐ guàn le de rén， dào yào bǐ cǐ quàn miǎn， jì zhī dào 〔 yuán wén zuò kàn jiàn 〕 nà rì zi lín jìn， jiù gèng dāng rú cǐ。

lessons.title: Numbers & Time
lessons.subtitle: 第六课 · 数字与时间
lessons.scenario: You're arranging a time to meet a friend for coffee before Bible study.

dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.chinese: 我们星期几见面比较好？
dialogue.pinyin: Wǒmen xīngqí jǐ jiànmiàn bǐjiào hǎo?
dialogue.english: Which day is better for us to meet?

dialogue.speaker: Hui Ling
dialogue.pinyin: Xīngqíwǔ bǐ xīngqísì fāngbiàn.
dialogue.english: Friday is more convenient than Thursday.

dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.pinyin: Jǐ diǎn jiànmiàn?
dialogue.english: What time shall we meet?

dialogue.speaker: Hui Ling
dialogue.pinyin: Xiàwǔ sān diǎn, kěyǐ ma?
dialogue.english: 3pm, is that okay?

dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.pinyin: Kěyǐ. Cházīng shì jǐ diǎn kāishǐ?
dialogue.english: Okay. What time does Bible study start?

dialogue.speaker: Hui Ling
dialogue.pinyin: Wǎnshàng qī diǎn bàn.

vocabulary.note: Refers to the activity itself, distinct from 小组 (the group) or 团契 (fellowship gathering).

lessons.challenge: Practice arranging a time with someone this week using 比较方便 (more convenient).

verse.chinese: 凡事都有定期，天下万务都有定时。
verse.pinyin: fán shì dōu yǒu dìng qī， tiān xià wàn wù dōu yǒu dìng shí。

lessons.title: Talking About Family
lessons.subtitle: 第七课 · 家人与近况
lessons.scenario: After service, Kevin asks about your family while catching up over coffee.

dialogue.speaker: Kevin
dialogue.pinyin: Jìnkuàng rúhé? Jiārén dōu hǎo ma?
dialogue.english: How's it going? Is your family well?

dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.chinese: 都好，谢谢关心。你呢？有兄弟姐妹吗？
dialogue.pinyin: Dōu hǎo, xièxie guānxīn. Nǐ ne? Yǒu xiōngdì jiěmèi ma?
dialogue.english: All good, thanks for asking. And you? Do you have siblings?

dialogue.speaker: Kevin
dialogue.chinese: 我有一个哥哥和一个妹妹。
dialogue.pinyin: Wǒ yǒu yīgè gēge hé yīgè mèimei.
dialogue.english: I have an older brother and a younger sister.

dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.pinyin: Tāmen yě shì Jīdūtú ma?
dialogue.english: Are they also Christians?

dialogue.speaker: Kevin
dialogue.chinese: 我妹妹是，我哥哥还没信主。
dialogue.pinyin: Wǒ mèimei shì, wǒ gēge hái méi xìn zhǔ.
dialogue.english: My sister is, my brother hasn't believed in the Lord yet.

dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.pinyin: Wǒ huì wèi tā dǎogào.
dialogue.english: I'll pray for him.

vocabulary.note: Polite and warm, used often.

quiz.question: What does 兄弟姐妹 mean?

lessons.challenge: Ask a friend about their 家人 (family) this week, and share about yours too.

verse.chinese: 若是你们以事奉耶和华为不好，今日就可以选择所要事奉的：是你们列祖在大河那边所事奉的神呢？是你们所住这地的亚摩利人的神呢？至于我和我家，我们必定事奉耶和华。」
verse.pinyin: ruò shì nǐ men yǐ shì fèng yē hé huá wèi bù hǎo， jīn rì jiù kě yǐ xuǎn zé suǒ yào shì fèng de： shì nǐ men liè zǔ zài dà hé nà biān suǒ shì fèng de shén ne？ shì nǐ men suǒ zhù zhè dì de yà mó lì rén de shén ne？ zhì yú wǒ hé wǒ jiā， wǒ men bì dìng shì fèng yē hé huá 。」

lessons.title: Exchanging Contact Info
lessons.subtitle: 第八课 · 交换联络方式
lessons.scenario: You've just met someone new at church and want to stay in touch.

dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.chinese: 你用WhatsApp吗？我们加个联络方式吧。
dialogue.pinyin: Nǐ yòng WhatsApp ma? Wǒmen jiā gè liánluò fāngshì ba.
dialogue.english: Do you use WhatsApp? Let's exchange contact info.

dialogue.speaker: Jia Hui
dialogue.chinese: 用，我给你我的手机号码。
dialogue.pinyin: Yòng, wǒ gěi nǐ wǒ de shǒujī hàomǎ.
dialogue.english: Yes, I'll give you my phone number.

dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.pinyin: Hǎo, wǒ yě bǎ hàomǎ gěi nǐ.
dialogue.english: Great, I'll give you mine too.

dialogue.speaker: Jia Hui
dialogue.pinyin: Xièxie, wǒmen bǎochí liánluò.
dialogue.english: Thanks, let's stay in touch.

dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.pinyin: Tài hǎo le!
dialogue.english: Great!

vocabulary.note: A warm, common expression of enthusiasm.

quiz.question: What does 联络方式 mean?
What does 手机号码 mean?
What does 保持联络 mean?

lessons.challenge: Exchange 联络方式 with someone new at church this week.

verse.chinese: 铁磨铁，磨出刃来；朋友相感〔原文作磨朋友的脸〕也是如此。
verse.pinyin: tiě mó tiě， mó chū rèn lái； péng yǒu xiāng gǎn 〔 yuán wén zuò mó péng yǒu de liǎn 〕 yě shì rú cǐ。

lessons.title: Joining a Small Group
lessons.subtitle: 第九课 · 加入小组
lessons.scenario: You'd like to join a small group (cell group) that meets weekly to study the Bible and pray together.

dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.chinese: 请问，你们小组什么时候聚会？
dialogue.pinyin: Qǐngwèn, nǐmen xiǎozǔ shénme shíhòu jùhuì?
dialogue.english: Excuse me, when does your small group meet?

dialogue.speaker: Grace Lim
dialogue.pinyin: Wǒmen xīngqísān wǎnshàng jùhuì.
dialogue.english: We meet on Wednesday evenings.

dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.pinyin: Zài nǎlǐ jùhuì?
dialogue.english: Where do you meet?

dialogue.speaker: Grace Lim
dialogue.pinyin: Zài dìxiōng zǐmèi de jiā lǐ.
dialogue.english: At a brother's or sister's home.

dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.pinyin: Tài hǎo le, wǒ kěyǐ jiārù ma?
dialogue.english: Great, can I join?

dialogue.speaker: Grace Lim
dialogue.pinyin: Dāngrán kěyǐ, huānyíng nǐ!
dialogue.english: Of course, welcome!

vocabulary.note: The common Singapore-church term for a home-based Bible study group.
Often heard from greeters at the door.
Common term for male fellow believers.
Common term for female fellow believers.
A warm, common expression of enthusiasm.

quiz.question: How do you ask "can I join?"

lessons.challenge: Ask a small group leader "你们小组什么时候聚会？" this week.

verse.chinese: 他们天天同心合意恒切的在殿里，且在家中擘饼，存着欢喜、诚实的心用饭，
verse.pinyin: tā men tiān tiān tóng xīn hé yì héng qiè de zài diàn lǐ， qiě zài jiā zhōng bāi bǐng， cún zhe huān xǐ、 chéng shí de xīn yòng fàn，

lessons.title: Sharing Prayer Requests
lessons.subtitle: 第十课 · 分享代祷事项
lessons.scenario: During small group, members take turns sharing what they'd like the group to pray for.

dialogue.speaker: Grace Lim
dialogue.pinyin: Yǒu méiyǒu dàidǎo shìxiàng?
dialogue.english: Does anyone have a prayer request?

dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.pinyin: Qǐng wèi wǒ de jiārén dǎogào.
dialogue.english: Please pray for my family.

dialogue.speaker: Grace Lim
dialogue.chinese: 好的，我们一起为你祷告。
dialogue.pinyin: Hǎo de, wǒmen yīqǐ wèi nǐ dǎogào.
dialogue.english: Okay, let's pray for you together.

dialogue.speaker: Kevin
dialogue.chinese: 我也想请大家为我的工作祷告。
dialogue.pinyin: Wǒ yě xiǎng qǐng dàjiā wèi wǒ de gōngzuò dǎogào.
dialogue.english: I'd also like everyone to pray for my work.

dialogue.speaker: Grace Lim
dialogue.pinyin: Méi wèntí, wǒmen jì xiàlái.
dialogue.english: No problem, we'll note it down.

quiz.question: What does 代祷事项 mean?

lessons.challenge: Share one prayer request with a brother or sister this week, using 请为...祷告.

verse.chinese: 所以你们要彼此认罪，互相代求，使你们可以得医治。义人祈祷所发的力量是大有功效的。
verse.pinyin: suǒ yǐ nǐ men yào bǐ cǐ rèn zuì， hù xiāng dài qiú， shǐ nǐ men kě yǐ dé yī zhì。 yì rén qí dǎo suǒ fā de lì liàng shì dà yǒu gōng xiào de。

lessons.title: Encouraging Others
lessons.subtitle: 第十一课 · 鼓励弟兄姊妹
lessons.scenario: After a hard week, you want to encourage a friend from church who seems discouraged.

dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.pinyin: Nǐ hái hǎo ma?
dialogue.english: Are you doing okay?

dialogue.speaker: Jia Hui
dialogue.pinyin: Zhège xīngqí yǒudiǎn xīnkǔ.
dialogue.english: This week has been a bit hard.

dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.pinyin: Shén yǔ nǐ tóngzài, bùyào huīxīn.
dialogue.english: God is with you, don't be discouraged.

dialogue.speaker: Jia Hui
dialogue.pinyin: Xièxie nǐ de gǔlì.
dialogue.english: Thank you for your encouragement.

dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.pinyin: Wǒ huì wèi nǐ dǎogào de.
dialogue.english: I'll pray for you.

vocabulary.note: The standard CUVS term for God.
Polite and warm, used often.

quiz.question: How do you say "God is with you"?
How do you say "thank you for your encouragement"?

lessons.challenge: Encourage someone at church this week with "神与你同在。"

verse.chinese: 所以，你们该彼此劝慰，互相建立，正如你们素常所行的。
verse.pinyin: suǒ yǐ， nǐ men gāi bǐ cǐ quàn wèi， hù xiāng jiàn lì， zhèng rú nǐ men sù cháng suǒ xíng de。

lessons.title: Giving Thanks
lessons.subtitle: 第十二课 · 感恩
lessons.scenario: At the end of a fellowship meal, someone asks you to share what you're thankful for.

dialogue.speaker: Grace Lim
dialogue.chinese: 我们来分享感恩事项吧。
dialogue.pinyin: Wǒmen lái fēnxiǎng gǎn'ēn shìxiàng ba.
dialogue.english: Let's share what we're thankful for.

dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.chinese: 我感谢神赐给我的教会家庭。
dialogue.pinyin: Wǒ gǎnxiè shén cì gěi wǒ de jiàohuì jiātíng.
dialogue.english: I'm thankful for the church family God has given me.

dialogue.speaker: Wei Ming
dialogue.pinyin: Wǒ gǎn'ēn zhè cì de tuánqì.
dialogue.english: I'm thankful for this fellowship gathering.

dialogue.speaker: Grace Lim
dialogue.pinyin: Ràng wǒmen yīqǐ gǎnxiè shén.
dialogue.english: Let's give thanks to God together.

vocabulary.note: Used especially of God giving something.
A common Singapore-church term for a fellowship group, distinct from 小组 (small group).
The community, not just the building.
The standard CUVS term for God.

quiz.question: How do you say "I'm thankful for..."?

lessons.challenge: Share one thing you're thankful for with someone at church this week.

verse.chinese: 凡事谢恩；因为这是神在基督耶稣里向你们所定的旨意。
verse.pinyin: fán shì xiè ēn； yīn wèi zhè shì shén zài jī dū yē sū lǐ xiàng nǐ men suǒ dìng de zhǐ yì。

lessons.title: Inviting a Friend to Church
lessons.subtitle: 第十三课 · 邀请朋友来教会
lessons.scenario: You'd like to invite a friend to join you at church this Sunday.

dialogue.speaker: Narrator
dialogue.pinyin: Nǐ xiǎng yāoqǐng Kevin yīqǐ qù jiàohuì.
dialogue.english: You want to invite Kevin to go to church together.

dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.pinyin: Zhège zhǔrì nǐ yǒu kòng ma?
dialogue.english: Are you free this Sunday?

dialogue.speaker: Kevin
dialogue.pinyin: Yǒu kòng, zěnme le?
dialogue.english: I'm free, why?

dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.chinese: 要不要跟我一起去教会？
dialogue.pinyin: Yào bùyào gēn wǒ yīqǐ qù jiàohuì?
dialogue.english: Would you like to go to church with me?

dialogue.speaker: Kevin
dialogue.pinyin: Hǎo a, jǐ diǎn kāishǐ?
dialogue.english: Sure, what time does it start?

dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.pinyin: Zǎoshang shí diǎn. Wǒ kěyǐ zài nǐ.
dialogue.english: 10am. I can give you a ride.

vocabulary.note: The common Singapore-church term for Sunday, as in 主日崇拜 and 主日学.
The community, not just the building.

quiz.question: How would you invite someone to church?
options: 要不要跟我一起去教会？
quiz.answer: 要不要跟我一起去教会？

lessons.challenge: Invite a friend to church this week using "要不要跟我一起去教会？"

verse.chinese: 拿但业对他说：「拿撒勒还能出甚么好的么？」腓力说：「你来看！」
verse.pinyin: ná dàn yè duì tā shuō ：「 ná sā lēi hái néng chū shén me hǎo de me ？」 féi lì shuō ：「 nǐ lái kàn ！」

lessons.title: Christmas at Church
lessons.subtitle: 第十四课 · 教会的圣诞节
lessons.scenario: It's December, and your small group is preparing to go carolling and helping with the church's Christmas program.

dialogue.speaker: Grace Lim
dialogue.chinese: 我们圣诞节要去报佳音。
dialogue.pinyin: Wǒmen shèngdànjié yào qù bào jiāyīn.
dialogue.english: We're going carolling for Christmas.

dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.pinyin: Bào jiāyīn shì zuò shénme?
dialogue.english: What does carolling involve?

dialogue.speaker: Grace Lim
dialogue.chinese: 我们唱圣诞歌，分享耶稣降生的好消息。
dialogue.pinyin: Wǒmen chàng shèngdàn gē, fēnxiǎng Yēsū jiàngshēng de hǎo xiāoxi.
dialogue.english: We sing Christmas songs and share the good news of Jesus's birth.

dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.chinese: 耶稣是在伯利恒出生的吗？
dialogue.pinyin: Yēsū shì zài Bólìhéng chūshēng de ma?
dialogue.english: Was Jesus born in Bethlehem?

dialogue.speaker: Grace Lim
dialogue.pinyin: Duì, zài mácáo lǐ.
dialogue.english: Yes, in a manger.

vocabulary.note: Literally 'to proclaim good news' — the common Singapore-church term for Christmas carolling visits.
Used specifically of Christ's birth.

lessons.challenge: Invite a friend to your church's 圣诞节 (Christmas) service or program this year.

verse.chinese: 因今天在大卫的城里，为你们生了救主，就是主基督。
verse.pinyin: yīn jīn tiān zài dà wèi de chéng lǐ， wèi nǐ men shēng le jiù zhǔ， jiù shì zhǔ jī dū。

lessons.title: When Someone is Sick
lessons.subtitle: 第十五课 · 探病与代祷
lessons.scenario: A member of your small group is in the hospital, and you're figuring out how to support them.

dialogue.speaker: Grace Lim
dialogue.chinese: 你听说了吗？王姐妹住院了。
dialogue.pinyin: Nǐ tīngshuō le ma? Wáng zǐmèi zhùyuàn le.
dialogue.english: Did you hear? Sister Wang is hospitalised.

dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.pinyin: Wǒ bù zhīdào, tā zěnme le?
dialogue.english: I didn't know, what happened to her?

dialogue.speaker: Grace Lim
dialogue.pinyin: Tā fāshāo, yīshēng zài jiǎnchá.
dialogue.english: She has a fever, the doctor is examining her.

dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.pinyin: Wǒmen yīnggāi qù tànbìng ma?
dialogue.english: Should we go visit her?

dialogue.speaker: Grace Lim
dialogue.chinese: 好，我们也一起为她代祷。
dialogue.pinyin: Hǎo, wǒmen yě yīqǐ wèi tā dàidǎo.
dialogue.english: Yes, let's also pray for her together.

lessons.challenge: If someone in your church is unwell this week, offer to 探病 or 代祷 for them.

verse.chinese: 你们中间有病了的呢，他就该请教会的长老来；他们可以奉主的名用油抹他，为他祷告。
verse.pinyin: nǐ men zhōng jiān yǒu bìng le de ne， tā jiù gāi qǐng jiào huì de zhǎng lǎo lái； tā men kě yǐ fèng zhǔ de míng yòng yóu mǒ tā， wèi tā dǎo gào。

lessons.title: A Church Wedding
lessons.subtitle: 第十六课 · 教会婚礼
lessons.scenario: You're attending a fellow church member's wedding and talking with a friend about the ceremony.

dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.chinese: 今天的婚礼在哪里举行？
dialogue.pinyin: Jīntiān de hūnlǐ zài nǎlǐ jǔxíng?
dialogue.english: Where is today's wedding being held?

dialogue.speaker: Wei Ming
dialogue.chinese: 在主堂举行，牧师会证婚。
dialogue.pinyin: Zài zhǔ táng jǔxíng, mùshī huì zhènghūn.
dialogue.english: It's in the main sanctuary, the pastor will officiate.

dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.chinese: 新郎新娘是我们教会的吗？
dialogue.pinyin: Xīnláng xīnniáng shì wǒmen jiàohuì de ma?
dialogue.english: Are the bride and groom from our church?

dialogue.speaker: Wei Ming
dialogue.chinese: 是的，他们在小组认识的。
dialogue.pinyin: Shì de, tāmen zài xiǎozǔ rènshi de.
dialogue.english: Yes, they met in small group.

dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.pinyin: Zhēn gǎn'ēn! Wǒmen zhùfú tāmen.
dialogue.english: What a blessing! Let's bless them.

vocabulary.note: The community, not just the building.
The common Singapore-church term for a home-based Bible study group.

lessons.challenge: Next time you attend a church 婚礼 (wedding), offer the couple a blessing in Chinese.

verse.chinese: 因此，人要离开父母，与妻子连合，二人成为一体。
verse.pinyin: yīn cǐ， rén yào lí kāi fù mǔ， yǔ qī zǐ lián hé， èr rén chéng wéi yī tǐ。

lessons.title: Reading the Bible
lessons.subtitle: 第十七课 · 灵修与读经
lessons.scenario: You want to start a daily devotional habit and ask a friend how they do their personal Bible reading time.

dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.pinyin: Nǐ měitiān dōu língxiū ma?
dialogue.english: Do you have a quiet time every day?

dialogue.speaker: Hui Ling
dialogue.chinese: 是的，我每天早上读经祷告。
dialogue.pinyin: Shì de, wǒ měitiān zǎoshang dú jīng dǎogào.
dialogue.english: Yes, I read the Bible and pray every morning.

dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.pinyin: Nǐ yòng shénme língxiū cáiliào?
dialogue.english: What devotional material do you use?

dialogue.speaker: Hui Ling
dialogue.chinese: 我用一本读经手册，每天一章。
dialogue.pinyin: Wǒ yòng yī běn dú jīng shǒucè, měitiān yī zhāng.
dialogue.english: I use a devotional guide, one chapter a day.

dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.chinese: 我也想开始，你可以介绍给我吗？
dialogue.pinyin: Wǒ yě xiǎng kāishǐ, nǐ kěyǐ jièshào gěi wǒ ma?
dialogue.english: I'd like to start too — can you recommend one to me?

dialogue.speaker: Hui Ling
dialogue.chinese: 当然可以！圣经真的能帮助我们天天亲近神。
dialogue.pinyin: Dāngrán kěyǐ! Shèngjīng zhēn de néng bāngzhù wǒmen tiāntiān qīnjìn shén.
dialogue.english: Of course! The Bible really can help us draw near to God every day.

lessons.challenge: Start a daily 灵修 this week — read one chapter and note what stood out to you.

verse.chinese: 你的话是我脚前的灯，是我路上的光。
verse.pinyin: nǐ de huà shì wǒ jiǎo qián de dēng， shì wǒ lù shàng de guāng。

lessons.title: Salvation
lessons.subtitle: 第十八课 · 救恩
lessons.scenario: A friend asks you to explain what it means to be saved, and you share simply what the Bible teaches.

dialogue.speaker: Jia Hui
dialogue.pinyin: Shénme shì jiù'ēn?
dialogue.english: What is salvation?

dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.chinese: 救恩是神因着恩典赦免我们的罪。
dialogue.pinyin: Jiù'ēn shì shén yīnzhe ēndiǎn shèmiǎn wǒmen de zuì.
dialogue.english: Salvation is God forgiving our sins by grace.

dialogue.speaker: Jia Hui
dialogue.pinyin: Wǒmen yào zěnme dédào jiù'ēn?
dialogue.english: How do we receive salvation?

dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.chinese: 因信耶稣基督，我们就得救了。
dialogue.pinyin: Yīn xìn Yēsū Jīdū, wǒmen jiù déjiù le.
dialogue.english: By believing in Jesus Christ, we are saved.

dialogue.speaker: Jia Hui
dialogue.pinyin: Zhè shì kào xíngwéi ma?
dialogue.english: Is this based on good works?

dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.chinese: 不是，是神的恩典，不是行为。
dialogue.pinyin: Bùshì, shì shén de ēndiǎn, bùshì xíngwéi.
dialogue.english: No, it's by God's grace, not works.

vocabulary.note: The term used throughout the Chinese Union Version (和合本, CUVS) Bible.
The standard CUVS term for God.

lessons.challenge: Practice explaining 救恩 in one simple sentence to a friend this week.

verse.chinese: 你们得救是本乎恩，也因着信；这并不是出于自己，乃是神所赐的；
verse.pinyin: nǐ men dé jiù shì běn hū ēn， yě yīn zhe xìn； zhè bìng bú shì chū yú zì jǐ， nǎi shì shén suǒ cì de；

lessons.title: Baptism
lessons.subtitle: 第十九课 · 洗礼
lessons.scenario: You're thinking about getting baptised and ask a church leader what the process involves.

dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.pinyin: Wǒ xiǎng shòuxǐ, yīnggāi zěnme zuò?
dialogue.english: I'd like to be baptised — what should I do?

dialogue.speaker: Pastor Koh
dialogue.chinese: 太好了！你需要先上洗礼班。
dialogue.pinyin: Tài hǎo le! Nǐ xūyào xiān shàng xǐlǐ bān.
dialogue.english: Wonderful! You'll need to attend the baptism class first.

dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.pinyin: Xǐlǐ bān jiāo xiē shénme?
dialogue.english: What does the baptism class teach?

dialogue.speaker: Pastor Koh
dialogue.pinyin: Jiāo nǐ xìnyǎng de jīběn yàodào.
dialogue.english: It teaches the basics of the faith.

dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.pinyin: Xǐlǐ shì shénme shíhòu jǔxíng?
dialogue.english: When is the baptism held?

dialogue.speaker: Pastor Koh
dialogue.chinese: 通常在主日崇拜的时候。
dialogue.pinyin: Tōngcháng zài zhǔrì chóngbài de shíhòu.
dialogue.english: Usually during the Sunday worship service.

vocabulary.note: A warm, common expression of enthusiasm.
The standard term in Singapore Protestant churches (as in 主日崇拜, 'Sunday worship service'). You may also hear 礼拜 used colloquially, especially for 'attending church' (做礼拜).
The common Singapore-church term for Sunday, as in 主日崇拜 and 主日学.

lessons.challenge: Ask a church leader this week what the 洗礼班 (baptism class) involves.

verse.chinese: 所以，我们借着洗礼归入死，和他一同埋葬，原是叫我们一举一动有新生的样式，像基督借着父的荣耀从死里复活一样。
verse.pinyin: suǒ yǐ， wǒ men jiè zhe xǐ lǐ guī rù sǐ， hé tā yī tóng mái zàng， yuán shì jiào wǒ men yī jǔ yī dòng yǒu xīn shēng de yàng shì， xiàng jī dū jiè zhe fù de róng yào cóng sǐ lǐ fù huó yī yàng。

lessons.title: Communion
lessons.subtitle: 第二十课 · 圣餐
lessons.scenario: It's your first time attending a communion service, and you ask a friend what to expect.

dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.chinese: 今天有圣餐礼，是怎样的？
dialogue.pinyin: Jīntiān yǒu shèngcān lǐ, shì zěnyàng de?
dialogue.english: There's communion today — what's it like?

dialogue.speaker: Wei Ming
dialogue.chinese: 我们领饼和杯，记念主耶稣。
dialogue.pinyin: Wǒmen lǐng bǐng hé bēi, jìniàn zhǔ Yēsū.
dialogue.english: We receive bread and the cup, remembering the Lord Jesus.

dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.pinyin: Bǐng hé bēi dàibiǎo shénme?
dialogue.english: What do the bread and cup represent?

dialogue.speaker: Wei Ming
dialogue.pinyin: Dàibiǎo zhǔ de shēntǐ hé bǎoxuè.
dialogue.english: They represent the Lord's body and precious blood.

dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.pinyin: Shéi kěyǐ lǐng shèngcān?
dialogue.english: Who can take communion?

dialogue.speaker: Wei Ming
dialogue.chinese: 已经受洗的信徒都可以。
dialogue.pinyin: Yǐjīng shòuxǐ de xìntú dōu kěyǐ.
dialogue.english: Any baptised believer can.

lessons.challenge: During communion this week, take a moment to reflect on what 记念主耶稣 means to you.

verse.chinese: 祝谢了，就擘开，说：「这是我的身体，为你们舍〔有古卷作：擘开〕的，你们应当如此行，为的是记念我。」
verse.pinyin: zhù xiè le， jiù bāi kāi， shuō ：「 zhè shì wǒ de shēn tǐ， wèi nǐ men shě 〔 yǒu gǔ juǎn zuò： bāi kāi 〕 de， nǐ men yīng dāng rú cǐ xíng， wèi de shì jì niàn wǒ 。」

lessons.title: Sharing Your Testimony
lessons.subtitle: 第二十一课 · 分享见证
lessons.scenario: Your small group leader invites you to share your testimony — the story of how you came to know Christ.

dialogue.speaker: Grace Lim
dialogue.chinese: 你愿意分享你的见证吗？
dialogue.pinyin: Nǐ yuànyì fēnxiǎng nǐ de jiànzhèng ma?
dialogue.english: Would you like to share your testimony?

dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.pinyin: Hǎo de. Wǒ yǐqián bù rènshi shén.
dialogue.english: Okay. I didn't know God before.

dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.chinese: 后来朋友带我去教会，我决定信主。
dialogue.pinyin: Hòulái péngyǒu dài wǒ qù jiàohuì, wǒ juédìng xìn zhǔ.
dialogue.english: Later a friend brought me to church, and I decided to believe in the Lord.

dialogue.speaker: Grace Lim
dialogue.chinese: 神怎样改变了你的生命？
dialogue.pinyin: Shén zěnyàng gǎibiàn le nǐ de shēngmìng?
dialogue.english: How has God changed your life?

dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.chinese: 我学会了饶恕，也更有平安。
dialogue.pinyin: Wǒ xuéhuì le ráoshù, yě gèng yǒu píng'ān.
dialogue.english: I learned to forgive, and I have more peace.

vocabulary.note: The community, not just the building.
A common greeting among Singapore Protestant believers, often short for 主内平安 ('peace in the Lord').
The standard CUVS term for God.

lessons.challenge: Write down two or three sentences of your own 见证 this week.

verse.chinese: 只要心里尊主基督为圣。有人问你们心中盼望的缘由，就要常作准备，以温柔、敬畏的心回答各人；
verse.pinyin: zhǐ yào xīn lǐ zūn zhǔ jī dū wèi shèng。 yǒu rén wèn nǐ men xīn zhōng pàn wàng de yuán yóu， jiù yào cháng zuò zhǔn bèi， yǐ wēn róu、 jìng wèi de xīn huí dá gè rén；

lessons.title: Finding Your Way in the Bible
lessons.subtitle: 第二十二课 · 认识圣经的书卷
lessons.scenario: Before your first Bible study, a friend helps you understand how the Bible is organised so you can find passages quickly.

dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.chinese: 圣经要怎么分？我不太懂。
dialogue.pinyin: Shèngjīng yào zěnme fēn? Wǒ bù tài dǒng.
dialogue.english: How is the Bible divided? I don't quite understand.

dialogue.speaker: Hui Ling
dialogue.pinyin: Shèngjīng fēnchéng jiùyuē hé xīnyuē.
dialogue.english: The Bible is divided into the Old Testament and New Testament.

dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.pinyin: Jiùyuē jiǎng shénme?
dialogue.english: What does the Old Testament talk about?

dialogue.speaker: Hui Ling
dialogue.chinese: 从创世记开始，讲神创造世界，也有诗篇这样的诗歌。
dialogue.pinyin: Cóng Chuàngshìjì kāishǐ, jiǎng shén chuàngzào shìjiè, yě yǒu shīpiān zhèyàng de shīgē.
dialogue.english: It starts with Genesis, about God creating the world, and also has poetry like Psalms.

dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.pinyin: Nà xīnyuē ne?
dialogue.english: And the New Testament?

dialogue.speaker: Hui Ling
dialogue.chinese: 新约有四福音书，讲耶稣的生平。
dialogue.pinyin: Xīnyuē yǒu sì fúyīnshū, jiǎng Yēsū de shēngpíng.
dialogue.english: The New Testament has the four Gospels, about Jesus's life.

vocabulary.note: The first book of the Bible.
Refers to Matthew, Mark, Luke, and John.
The standard CUVS term for God.

lessons.challenge: Before your next Bible study, look up where 诗篇 (Psalms) is in your Bible's contents page.

verse.chinese: 圣经都是神所默示的〔或作：凡神所默示的圣经〕，于教训、督责、使人归正、教导人学义都是有益的，
verse.pinyin: shèng jīng dōu shì shén suǒ mò shì de 〔 huò zuò： fán shén suǒ mò shì de shèng jīng 〕， yú jiào xùn、 dū zé、 shǐ rén guī zhèng、 jiào dǎo rén xué yì dōu shì yǒu yì de，

lessons.title: Bible People You'll Hear About
lessons.subtitle: 第二十三课 · 圣经中的人物
lessons.scenario: After a sermon that mentioned several names, a friend explains who they were.

dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.chinese: 牧师今天讲道提到摩西，他是谁？
dialogue.pinyin: Mùshī jīntiān jiǎngdào tídào Móxī, tā shì shéi?
dialogue.english: The pastor mentioned Moses today — who is he?

dialogue.speaker: Kevin
dialogue.chinese: 摩西带领以色列人出埃及。
dialogue.pinyin: Móxī dàilǐng Yǐsèliè rén chū Āijí.
dialogue.english: Moses led the Israelites out of Egypt.

dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.pinyin: Nà Yàbólāhǎn ne?
dialogue.english: What about Abraham?

dialogue.speaker: Kevin
dialogue.pinyin: Yàbólāhǎn shì xìnxīn zhī fù.
dialogue.english: Abraham is the father of faith.

dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.pinyin: Bǎoluó shì Yēsū de méntú ma?
dialogue.english: Is Paul one of Jesus's disciples?

dialogue.speaker: Kevin
dialogue.chinese: 不是，他是使徒，写了很多书信。
dialogue.pinyin: Bùshì, tā shì shǐtú, xiěle hěnduō shūxìn.
dialogue.english: No, he's an apostle who wrote many letters.

dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.pinyin: Xiānzhī shì zuò shénme de?
dialogue.english: What do prophets do?

dialogue.speaker: Kevin
dialogue.chinese: 先知代表神向百姓传话。
dialogue.pinyin: Xiānzhī dàibiǎo shén xiàng bǎixìng chuánhuà.
dialogue.english: Prophets speak God's message to the people on His behalf.

quiz.question: 亚伯拉罕 is known as...?

lessons.challenge: Next time a sermon mentions a Bible name you don't know, ask a friend "他是谁？" (who is he?).

verse.chinese: 我们既有这许多的见证人，如同云彩围着我们，就当放下各样的重担，脱去容易缠累我们的罪，存心忍耐，奔那摆在我们前头的路程，
verse.pinyin: wǒ men jì yǒu zhè xǔ duō de jiàn zhèng rén， rú tóng yún cǎi wéi zhe wǒ men， jiù dāng fàng xià gè yàng de zhòng dàn， tuō qù róng yì chán lèi wǒ men de zuì， cún xīn rěn nài， bēn nà bǎi zài wǒ men qián tou de lù chéng，

lessons.title: The Father, Son, and Spirit
lessons.subtitle: 第二十四课 · 天父、圣子、圣灵
lessons.scenario: At the end of the service, the pastor gives a blessing mentioning the Father, Son, and Spirit — a friend explains what it means.

dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.chinese: 牧师说"愿天父、圣子、圣灵与你们同在"，是什么意思？
dialogue.pinyin: Mùshī shuō "yuàn tiānfù, shèngzǐ, shènglíng yǔ nǐmen tóngzài", shì shénme yìsi?
dialogue.english: The pastor said "may the Father, Son, and Holy Spirit be with you" — what does that mean?

dialogue.speaker: Wei Ming
dialogue.chinese: 这是三位一体：天父、耶稣、圣灵。
dialogue.pinyin: Zhè shì sānwèiyītǐ: tiānfù, Yēsū, shènglíng.
dialogue.english: This is the Trinity: the Father, Jesus, and the Holy Spirit.

dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.pinyin: Shènglíng zhù zài xìntú xīnlǐ ma?
dialogue.english: Does the Holy Spirit live in believers' hearts?

dialogue.speaker: Wei Ming
dialogue.chinese: 对，圣灵帮助我们、引导我们。
dialogue.pinyin: Duì, shènglíng bāngzhù wǒmen, yǐndǎo wǒmen.
dialogue.english: Yes, the Holy Spirit helps and guides us.

dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.pinyin: Gǎnxiè zhǔ de ēndiǎn.
dialogue.english: Thank the Lord for His grace.

quiz.question: What does 三位一体 mean?

lessons.challenge: Listen for the words 天父, 圣灵, and 主 during this week's service or prayer.

verse.chinese: 愿主耶稣基督的恩惠、神的慈爱、圣灵的感动，常与你们众人同在！
verse.pinyin: yuàn zhǔ yē sū jī dū de ēn huì、 shén de cí ài、 shèng líng de gǎn dòng， cháng yǔ nǐ men zhòng rén tóng zài！

lessons.title: Easter: He is Risen
lessons.subtitle: 第二十五课 · 复活节：主复活了
lessons.scenario: It's the week of Good Friday and Easter Sunday, and you're talking with a friend about what the church is remembering.

dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.chinese: 这个星期是受难日和复活节吗？
dialogue.pinyin: Zhège xīngqí shì nànrì hé fùhuójié ma?
dialogue.english: Is this week Good Friday and Easter?

dialogue.speaker: Jia Hui
dialogue.chinese: 对，受难日记念主耶稣钉十字架。
dialogue.pinyin: Duì, nànrì jìniàn zhǔ Yēsū dīng shízìjià.

lessons.title: Repentance & Growing in Christ
lessons.subtitle: 第二十七课 · 悔改与生命成长
lessons.scenario: In Bible study, the group discusses what it means to repent and keep growing spiritually.

dialogue.speaker: Pastor Koh
dialogue.pinyin: Huǐgǎi shì shénme yìsi?
dialogue.english: What does it mean to repent?

dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.chinese: 是承认自己的罪，转向神。
dialogue.pinyin: Shì chéngrèn zìjǐ de zuì, zhuǎnxiàng shén.
dialogue.english: It's admitting our sin and turning to God.

dialogue.speaker: Pastor Koh
dialogue.pinyin: Rúguǒ wǒmen diēdǎo le ne?
dialogue.english: What if we stumble?

dialogue.speaker: You

dialogue.pinyin: Wǒmen kěyǐ zàicì huǐgǎi, shén huì shèmiǎn.
dialogue.english: We can repent again, and God will forgive.

dialogue.speaker: Pastor Koh

dialogue.english: Growing in Christ takes time.

vocabulary.note: The standard CUVS term for God.

lessons.title: Spiritual Gifts & the Fruit of the Spirit
lessons.subtitle: 第二十八课 · 恩赐与圣灵的果子
lessons.scenario: Your small group discusses spiritual gifts and the fruit of the Spirit during a study on 1 Corinthians and Galatians.

dialogue.speaker: Hui Ling
dialogue.chinese: 你知道自己的恩赐是什么吗？
dialogue.pinyin: Nǐ zhīdào zìjǐ de ēncì shì shénme ma?
dialogue.english: Do you know what your spiritual gift is?

dialogue.speaker: Hui Ling

dialogue.english: I have more of a gift for serving.

dialogue.english: Right, fruit is character, gifts are abilities.

lessons.challenge: Ask a friend or leader what they think your 恩赐 (spiritual gift) might be.

lessons.title: Explaining the Gospel
lessons.subtitle: 第三十三课 · 传福音
lessons.scenario: A coworker asks you what Christians actually believe, and you have the chance to share the Gospel simply.

dialogue.speaker: Narrator
dialogue.chinese: 大卫今天约了Daniel，要向他传福音。
dialogue.pinyin: Dàwèi jīntiān yuē le Daniel, yào xiàng tā chuán fúyīn.
dialogue.english: David arranged to meet Daniel today, planning to share the Gospel with him.

dialogue.speaker: Daniel
dialogue.chinese: 你每个星期天都去教会，你们到底信什么？
dialogue.pinyin: Nǐ měi gè xīngqítiān dōu qù jiàohuì, nǐmen dàodǐ xìn shénme?
dialogue.english: You go to church every Sunday — what do you guys actually believe?

dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.chinese: 简单来说，我们相信神爱世人，也相信耶稣为我们的罪死在十字架上。
dialogue.pinyin: Jiǎndān lái shuō, wǒmen xiāngxìn shén ài shìrén, yě xiāngxìn Yēsū wèi wǒmen de zuì sǐ zài shízìjià shàng.
dialogue.english: Simply put, we believe God loves the world, and that Jesus died on the cross for our sins.

dialogue.speaker: Daniel
dialogue.pinyin: Zuì? Wǒ yòu méi zuò shénme huàishì.
dialogue.english: Sin? I haven't done anything bad.

dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.chinese: 罪不只是坏事，也包括我们跟神的关系破裂。神却主动来救我们。
dialogue.pinyin: Zuì bùzhǐ shì huàishì, yě bāokuò wǒmen gēn shén de guānxi pòliè. Shén què zhǔdòng lái jiù wǒmen.
dialogue.english: Sin isn't just doing bad things — it's also our broken relationship with God. But God took the initiative to save us.

dialogue.speaker: Daniel
dialogue.pinyin: Nà wǒ gāi zěnme huíyìng?
dialogue.english: So how should I respond?

dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.chinese: 只要相信耶稣，接受祂做你的救主就可以了。
dialogue.pinyin: Zhǐyào xiāngxìn Yēsū, jiēshòu tā zuò nǐ de jiùzhǔ jiù kěyǐ le.
dialogue.english: Just believe in Jesus and receive Him as your Savior.

dialogue.speaker: Daniel
dialogue.chinese: 我需要想一想，谢谢你愿意跟我分享。
dialogue.pinyin: Wǒ xūyào xiǎng yī xiǎng, xièxie nǐ yuànyì gēn wǒ fēnxiǎng.
dialogue.english: I need to think about it. Thanks for being willing to share this with me.

vocabulary.note: The standard CUVS term for God.

dialogue.pinyin: Wǒ míngbái le, xièxie nǐ jiěshì.
dialogue.english: I understand, thanks for explaining.

vocabulary.note: Polite and warm, used often.

quiz.question: What does 甘心乐意 mean?

lessons.challenge: If you give an offering this week, reflect on doing so 甘心乐意 (willingly and cheerfully).

verse.chinese: 各人要随本心所酌定的，不要作难，不要勉强，因为捐得乐意的人是神所喜爱的。
verse.pinyin: gè rén yào suí běn xīn suǒ zhuó dìng de， bú yào zuò nán， bú yào miǎn qiǎng， yīn wèi juān dé lè yì de rén shì shén suǒ xǐ ài de。

lessons.title: Discipling a New Believer
lessons.subtitle: 第三十七课 · 栽培新信徒
lessons.scenario: You've been asked to help disciple someone who recently became a Christian, meeting regularly to help them grow.

dialogue.speaker: Grace Lim
dialogue.pinyin: Nǐ yuànyì zāipéi tā ma?
dialogue.english: Would you be willing to disciple him?

dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.chinese: 好的，我们应该多久见一次面？
dialogue.pinyin: Hǎo de, wǒmen yīnggāi duōjiǔ jiàn yī cì miàn?
dialogue.english: Okay, how often should we meet?

dialogue.speaker: Grace Lim
dialogue.pinyin: Měige xīngqí yī cì bǐjiào hǎo.
dialogue.english: Once a week is better.

dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.chinese: 我们可以一起读经、祷告。
dialogue.pinyin: Wǒmen kěyǐ yīqǐ dú jīng, dǎogào.
dialogue.english: We can read Scripture and pray together.

dialogue.speaker: Grace Lim
dialogue.chinese: 对，也可以回答他的问题。
dialogue.pinyin: Duì, yě kěyǐ huídá tā de wèntí.
dialogue.english: Yes, and answer his questions too.

vocabulary.note: Literally 'to cultivate' — the common church term for mentoring a newer believer.

lessons.challenge: If you're able to, offer to 栽培 (disciple) someone newer in the faith this month.

verse.chinese: 你在许多见证人面前听见我所教训的，也要交托那忠心能教导别人的人。
verse.pinyin: nǐ zài xǔ duō jiàn zhèng rén miàn qián tīng jiàn wǒ suǒ jiào xùn de， yě yào jiāo tuō nà zhōng xīn néng jiào dǎo bié rén de rén。

lessons.title: Preparing for a Mission Trip
lessons.subtitle: 第三十八课 · 短宣准备
lessons.scenario: You're preparing for a short-term mission trip and meeting with the team to go over details.

dialogue.speaker: Pastor Koh
dialogue.pinyin: Duǎnxuān duì xià gè yuè chūfā.
dialogue.english: The short-term mission team departs next month.

dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.chinese: 如果我参加，需要准备什么？
dialogue.pinyin: Rúguǒ wǒ cānjiā, xūyào zhǔnbèi shénme?
dialogue.english: If I join, what do I need to prepare?

dialogue.speaker: Pastor Koh
dialogue.chinese: 需要护照，也要为当地人祷告。
dialogue.pinyin: Xūyào hùzhào, yě yào wèi dāngdì rén dǎogào.
dialogue.english: You'll need a passport, and also to pray for the local people.

dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.pinyin: Wǒmen huì zuò shénme fúshì?
dialogue.english: What kind of ministry will we do?

dialogue.speaker: Pastor Koh
dialogue.chinese: 探访、教儿童，也分享福音。
dialogue.pinyin: Tànfǎng, jiāo értóng, yě fēnxiǎng fúyīn.
dialogue.english: Visitation, teaching children, and sharing the Gospel.

lessons.challenge: Pray for a missions team from your church this week, even if you're not going yourself.

verse.chinese: 所以，你们要去，使万民作我的门徒，奉父、子、圣灵的名给他们施洗〔或作：给他们施洗，归于父、子、圣灵的名〕。
verse.pinyin: suǒ yǐ， nǐ men yào qù， shǐ wàn mín zuò wǒ de mén tú， fèng fù、 zi、 shèng líng de míng gěi tā men shī xǐ 〔 huò zuò： gěi tā men shī xǐ， guī yú fù、 zi、 shèng líng de míng 〕。
